candidate_sentence_map.S1: Telia Lietuva, AB delivered strong financial performance in the first half of 2026, characterized by solid revenue growth and marked improvement in profitability.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total revenue increased by 7.2 percent to EUR 259.1 million, driven by a 6.7 percent rise in service revenue and a 7.2 percent increase in equipment sales.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Growth spanned both consumer and enterprise segments, with mobile services advancing 8.3 percent and fixed services growing 5.3 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Profitability expanded sharply, as operating profit climbed 15.1 percent to EUR 62.4 million and profit for the period rose 14.7 percent to EUR 51.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: EBITDA increased by 9.5 percent to EUR 105.5 million, supported by pricing discipline and operational efficiencies that pushed the EBITDA margin above 40 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: These gains held despite a statutory corporate tax rate increase to 17 percent at the beginning of the year.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Operating expenses rose by 11.3 percent, primarily due to EUR 1.4 million in non-recurring restructuring costs within the Digital and Technology unit, alongside higher energy procurement and external IT service fees.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Nevertheless, productivity improvements partially neutralized these pressures, as the total headcount decreased by nearly 7 percent to 1,601 employees.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: The company’s cash generation remained robust, with operating cash flow increasing by 15.0 percent to EUR 103.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Consequently, free cash flow advanced by 12.5 percent to EUR 64.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: On the balance sheet, Telia Lietuva transformed its financing position, converting a prior-year net debt balance into a net cash position of minus EUR 4.3 million by late June.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: This improved liquidity facilitated a record dividend distribution of EUR 81.6 million, or EUR 0.14 per share, covering the full 2025 fiscal year.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Strategic capital expenditure accelerated substantially, surging 57.9 percent to EUR 37.5 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The majority of investments targeted network modernization and digital infrastructure, including EUR 14.2 million for IT systems and EUR 9.7 million dedicated to spectrum licenses.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: A focal point of the period was the acquisition of two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for nearly EUR 8 million in a national regulatory auction, securing 40 MHz of spectrum specifically optimized for high-speed mobile data transmission.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The company also secured additional rights to the 2,100 MHz band for EUR 2 million to bolster 5G capacity.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Concurrently, fiber-optic coverage expanded to 992,000 households nationwide, while plans were initiated for a new data center project requiring up to EUR 26 million in phased investments through 2027.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Sustained mobile data traffic growth of approximately 25 percent annually continues to underpin network utilization.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Overall, the reporting period reflected disciplined execution, successful transition to stronger liquidity, and decisive reinvestment in future telecommunications infrastructure, supporting long-term competitive positioning.
